notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites:
The Trickster-God's Heist has one lore counter on it.
An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your first main phase, put a lore counter on The Trickster God's Heist, causing its second chapter ability to trigger.
Resolve the chapter ability, exchanging control of a nonbasic, noncreature permanent an opponent controls and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
